title: Nvidia stock hits all-time high, as market cap closes in on $6 trillion
source_used: Yahoo Finance (own article, fetched by the main session); Reuters market wrap on AOL.com for the record close.
key_facts: Nvidia stock hit a new all-time intraday high on Monday 5 Oct 2026, after eclipsing its prior high on Friday.
The stock opened at $236.07 and climbed to $239.86 by the afternoon; intraday market value hit $5.78 trillion, closer to $6 trillion.
Nvidia is riding continued spending on AI infrastructure amid the global build-out; it designs GPUs and associated networking.
In its August Q2 report Nvidia beat expectations with revenue of $96.2 billion and guided to Q3 sales of $105.8 billion to $110.1 billion.
Investors regularly question whether AI is a bubble; Nvidia's investing in its own customers, who then buy more chips ('circular investing'), has raised questions.
Competition: AMD recently launched its own rack-scale system; customers Amazon and Google offer their own custom chips to third parties.
Reuters (market wrap): Nvidia rose 2.1% on Monday to a record-high close, valuing it at $5.76 trillion.
quote_evidence: Nvidia (NVDA) stock hit a new all-time intraday high on Monday, after eclipsing its prior high on Friday.
The stock opened trading at $236.07 and climbed to $239.86 by the afternoon.
AI heavyweight Nvidia climbed 2.1% and also reached a record-high close, boosting its stock market value to $5.76 trillion.
why_it_matters_hint: A new record for the leading AI chip company shows investors still back AI infrastructure spending, though the article lists bubble and competition worries.
notes: Follow-up of Bloomberg's 2 Oct 2026 report (our 3 Oct 2026 edition): record touched on Friday, close just short. Today: new intraday high and, per Reuters, a record close. Intraday value $5.78 trillion (Yahoo) vs $5.76 trillion at the close (Reuters).
